description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19,999, ranged. Grants [Crystal Force Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode: Noel], [Instant ATB 1] to user. Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking] to user based on if entry damage was Ice/Water.

description.name: Crystal Force I
description.text: Four single attacks (2.00 each) capped at 19,999, ranged. Grants [Ice, Water Ability +30% Boost 1], [Dualcast Ice, Water 1], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1], [200% ATB 1] to user. After using Crystal Force, casts [Radiant Strike: Noel]

description.name: Crystal Force II
description.text: Four single attacks (2.00 each) capped at 19,999, ranged. Grants [Ice, Water Ability +30% Boost 1], [Dualcast Ice, Water 1], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1], [200% ATB 1] to user. After using Crystal Force, casts [Radiant Strike: Noel]

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Noel
description.text: Ice/Water abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice/Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode, triggers [Radiant Strike: Noel] after using Crystal Force abilities (max 1)

description.name: DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)
description.text: Ignores 25% of the target's DEF and RES

description.name: Radiant Strike: Noel
description.text: Grants [ATK and MND +15%, DEF and RES +25% (8s)] to all allies if user has Fate synergy, causes [DEF, RES and MND -50% (8s)] to target if not.

description.name: ATK and MND +15%, DEF and RES +25% (8s)
description.text: ATK and MND +15%, DEF and RES +25%

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3
